Open models on Groq through OpenAI's API shape: chat, responses, transcription, speech.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com/keys)
- **Setting:** `GROQ_API_KEY`
- **API reference:** [console.groq.com](https://console.groq.com/docs/api-reference)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to the [Groq console](https://console.groq.com).
2. Open [API Keys](https://console.groq.com/keys) and select **Create API Key**.
3. Copy the key. It's shown once.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
everyapp secret set GROQ_API_KEY
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

To make it the model provider apps get when they ask for the default:

```bash
everyapp ai default groq
```

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
providers: ["groq"],
```

The app calls `/api/ai/groq/…` with `createGatewayFetch()`. More in [AI](/docs/agent/ai).

### Check it worked

- `everyapp ai list` shows `groq` with its key set, and `everyapp ai show` says which provider apps get by default.
- `everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** Requests and tokens per minute and per day, per model and plan, for the whole organization; the console Limits page shows them.
